channel.title: Ask the Estimator — Kissimmee Concrete
channel.description: Short answers to real questions homeowners in Kissimmee, Osceola County and the Polk ridge ask about concrete and pavers.

item.title: My driveway in BVL has a 2-inch step at the garage. Can you just fix that panel?
item.description: Yes, if the rest of the drive is sound; we price the panel and the whole drive. Fix the downspout first. About $1,100 to $1,900 for a 10-by-12 panel.

item.title: We're in Solterra. Can we widen the driveway to fit a third car?
item.description: Solterra allows up to three cars wide with ARC approval; no added walking area; Polk permits the right-of-way portion.

item.title: Our new pavers in Weslyn Park have a white haze. Did the builder use bad pavers?
item.description: It is efflorescence, normal in the first season; clean it, then seal. Never seal over it.

item.title: Is my Poinciana house in Osceola or Polk for the permit?
item.description: Depends on the village; the permit finder checks the county boundary; the DCB application comes first either way.

item.title: Can you pour a patio in July or should we wait?
item.description: Yes, with a first-light start; July averages 16.7 rain days, almost all afternoon. Over 60 percent chance before 2 p.m. moves the pour.
